children: RNS Number : 2433W  Grafton Group PLC  25 September 2026
Completion of Ninth Share Buyback Programme

Grafton Group plc ("the Company"), the international building materials distributor and DIY retailer, is pleased to announce that it has completed its ninth share buyback programme that commenced on 30 June 2026.

Between 30 June 2026 and 24 September 2026, 2.6m ordinary shares in the Company were repurchased on the London Stock Exchange for cancellation at an average price of £9.58 per share and a total cost of £25m. This represented 1.38 per cent of the issued share capital of the Company when the ninth buyback programme commenced.
